metadata.title: Ganka CMS
metadata.description: Content management system of Ganka for Home.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: Access to the CMS is granted by an administrator once your email is confirmed.
signUp.successText: Open the link from the email to finish. If this address already has an account, the email says so.
signUp.devHint: Development: there is no mail provider yet, so the email is printed in the console of pnpm bdev. Open the link from it.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.description: Enter the password of your account to finish.
verifyEmail.successText: You can sign in once an administrator grants you access to the CMS.

errors.passwordTooShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.invalidCredentials: Wrong email or password, or this account has no access to the CMS.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.serverError: Something went wrong. Try again later.
